timelineSteps.title: 4 Months Before Departure: Microchip & Baseline Vaccine
timelineSteps.desc: Implant an ISO-compliant 15-digit microchip. Administer or update the Rabies vaccine. Ensure the chip number is noted on all medical charts.

timelineSteps.title: 3 Months Before Departure: Carrier Training & Airline Booking
timelineSteps.desc: Purchase an IATA-approved travel carrier (for dogs/cats). Start training your pet to sleep and rest inside it. Contact airlines to secure a space (cabin weight limits are usually 8kg/17lbs including the carrier; larger pets must travel as manifest cargo or checked baggage).

timelineSteps.title: 1 Month Before Departure: Vet Coordination
timelineSteps.desc: Schedule your USDA-accredited vet appointment within 10 days of your flight. Verify weather restrictions (airlines will not fly cargo pets if temperatures exceed 85°F/29°C at any layover point).

timelineSteps.title: 10 Days Before Departure: Health Certificate & Endorsement
timelineSteps.desc: Attend the vet appointment to issue the EU Health Certificate. Submit the paperwork electronically via the USDA Veterinary Export Health Certification System (VEHCS) portal to obtain the official APHIS seal.

timelineSteps.title: 48 Hours Before Departure: DGAV Notification
timelineSteps.desc: Send the DGAV entry notification form to your arrival airport’s vet inspection post (Lisbon, Porto, or Faro) with PDF copies of your flight ticket and endorsed health certificate.
